description: Starts email verification so the user can see branded resumes and videos or request introductions. Hire Overseas emails a 6-digit code to the address; then ask the user in chat for the code and call verify_email. Use the user's own work email; personal addresses are accepted but flagged.

company.description: The company the user is hiring for, if they gave it

email.description: The user's work email, e.g. 'ana@northwind.co'. The code is sent here.

name.description: The user's name, if they gave it

name: submit_email
title: Send a verification code to the user's work email
